item.title: Grace 0.5.0
item.description:
Export and import playlists as M3U.

  • Export Playlist…: from a playlist's context menu in the sidebar, or File → Export Playlist… (⇧⌘E). Writes an .m3u8 file with each track's title, length and cue points, which VLC also follows.
  • Import Playlist…: File → Import Playlist… (⇧⌘I) opens an .m3u or .m3u8 file as a new playlist, keeping its titles and cue points. Files that are missing or can't be played are listed in the warning bar and left out. The import can be undone.
